name: Facet

scenes.title: Your documents. Your rules.
scenes.result: Prove a fact. Keep the file private.
scenes.narration: A hiring application needs proof of training, not your entire certificate. Facet keeps digital documents private and lets you approve exactly which signed facts an application can see.

scenes.title: Connect your NEAR wallet
scenes.result: Signed login and holder binding verified
scenes.narration: The wallet identifies the holder through a signed NEAR login. This capture uses an injected test wallet with a real signature and live holder binding. Manual wallet compatibility remains unverified.

scenes.title: Keep a digital copy
scenes.narration: I upload fictional training notes. The original is encrypted in my local vault. My password stays on this device, and an encrypted backup preserves my documents and holder identity.

scenes.title: A record with clear limits
scenes.narration: A document NFT registers a salted fingerprint on NEAR. This self-recorded upload remains unverified. Registration alone does not authenticate a document or confer legal ownership.

scenes.title: Facts signed by an issuer
scenes.narration: The demo academy now signs a training credential. Its claims carry a real BBS signature and a holder-bound NEAR record. The academy and qualification are fictional.

scenes.title: Approve just enough
scenes.narration: The application requests course and completion. Before approving, I see those exact fields. Name, score, date and student reference stay hidden. The request also binds its purpose and a single-use nonce.

scenes.title: Verify without the original
scenes.narration: I approve and export a selective proof. A separate browser imports it without my vault or original document. The exported package excludes the hidden name and score.

scenes.title: A useful verified answer
scenes.narration: Verification succeeds. The application sees Data Privacy Foundations and Completed, alongside required public credential bindings. A real testnet transaction records the verification receipt and consumes the request nonce.

scenes.title: Shared current status
scenes.narration: NEAR anchors issuer keys, expiry, revocation and nonce use. Signature and disclosure checks run outside the contract. This gives applications a shared source of current credential status.

scenes.title: Stop future verification
scenes.narration: I prepare a fresh unused proof, then revoke the credential on NEAR. That proof is now rejected because of revocation. Revocation cannot erase facts already shared.

scenes.title: Let an agent prove just enough
scenes.badge:
PREVIEW ONLY
No grant created here
scenes.narration: For agents, this permission preview selects only course and completion. The planned delivery contains an approved presentation, keeping the original document and holder key private. This screen does not create a grant.

scenes.title: Set the limits yourself
scenes.badge:
PREVIEW ONLY
No TEE dispatch recorded
scenes.narration: The preview limits access to ten minutes and two executions. NEAR enforces signed permissions, usage, expiry and revocation. An agent can consume an existing capability without receiving the vault password.

scenes.title: A private home for credentials
scenes.narration: An optional OutLayer TEE copy stores the approved document, credential and holder key in sealed storage. NEAR authorizes private execution and wallet recovery. Plaintext documents are excluded from public chain records.

scenes.title: Show what has actually passed
scenes.result: Individual TEE checks passed; browser run incomplete
scenes.narration: Separate live tests passed TEE storage, agent delivery and recovery. The complete private browser workflow remains incomplete because some callbacks expire before settlement. This walkthrough shows agent previews, not a completed private agent run.

scenes.title: Inspect the NEAR integration
scenes.result: Public contract, worker hash and evidence
scenes.narration: The published contract and worker fingerprints make the integration inspectable. The TEE delivers browser-prepared proofs, and the demo agent uses deterministic checks. Try Facet and review the public code and evidence.

limitations: Edited genuine hosted screenshots, not an uninterrupted screen recording.
Injected NEAR Connect fixture: real NEP-413 signature and live wallet binding; manual wallet compatibility not demonstrated.
Agent permission screens are previews. This capture creates no grant and records no TEE dispatch.
Individual TEE operations have separate live evidence; complete private browser and locked-vault external HTTP flows remain unverified.
Fictional documents and issuer; real cryptography and NEAR testnet transactions.
The TEE delivers browser-prepared presentations. It does not derive fresh BBS proofs, and the demo agent uses no language model.
